problem_restatement.question: Would the staged V58 eight-asset topology create materially more evidence-supported trade opportunity than active V57, or mainly add weak and technically incomplete exposure?
success_criteria: bind every cadence and economic claim to the exact staged provider-symbol-side identity
separate technical route readiness from economic evidence
avoid summing overlapping or incompatible route rates into a portfolio forecast
retain adverse, sparse, and unresolved evidence
make no live strategy, sizing, route, or configuration change

active_baseline.interpretation: V57 remains the live baseline. This audit does not pause, restart, drain, or alter it.

method.cadence_definition: completed trades or exact eligible signals per the named source window
method.economic_definition: after-cost result under the named immutable replay or exact live lifecycle
method.identity_policy: older provider versions are descriptive priors only when the staged provider identity differs
method.sealed_data_policy: no sealed validation or holdout was opened by this audit

cadence_evidence.robust_v3: 1 exact forward signal in the explicit 2026-07-30T12:00Z to 2026-08-10T23:00Z replay window
cadence_evidence.tuned_v2: 106 completed trades over 338 covered days, approximately 2.2 per week
cadence_evidence.sweep_long: 6 development signals over 92 days and 1 forward signal in the later 12.5-day evidence window

route_assessments.economic_evidence: Robust v3 and sweep each have only one exact forward signal. Tuned v2 was positive in three partitions but was delay-sensitive and its latest exact signal would have stopped.

Development was +2298.23 bps, PF 1.8569, 3/5 positive folds, and +289.26 bps excluding the largest winner. The short side was negative excluding its largest winner and later confirmation contains only one aligned long.
Short development nominal was +$351.25, PF 2.6907, and +$180.38 excluding its largest winner; stress was +$300.33, PF 2.3163, and +$135.06 excluding its largest winner.
route_assessments.technical_contradiction: The pooled development report is NOT_SUITABLE_TECHNICALLY_UNRESOLVED; 11 nominal and stress lifecycles have unresolved entry-bar risk evidence.

route_assessments.economic_evidence: The sole exact short earned +$3.229665 after costs. It is one winner, provides no long-side evidence, and cannot establish repeatability or a profit factor.

economic_evidence.exact_v39_short_lifecycle: one small loss closed manually, so native exit behavior was not validated

route_assessments.economic_evidence: The first new exact eligible long hit the 60-bps stop for -69.1328 bps after exact visible-depth entry/exit, fees, and official funding. Three prior exact live lifecycles total only +$0.198733 and +$0.004716 excluding the largest winner.
The older non-fresh-v2 route produced two long protective-stop losses totaling -$1.343329. That side is not the staged short-only side and cannot validate V58 expectancy or cadence.

The older breakout route had 1 win and 1 loss, -$0.232469 net, PF 0.6621, and -$0.687962 excluding its largest winner. One close was an operator override. The separate oil-shock mechanism is not the staged route and failed stress evidence.

portfolio_opportunity_assessment.accepted_diagnosis: V58 would probably fire more often than V57, but the evidence does not establish that the added events are profitable opportunity rather than added loss exposure.

recommendation.single_highest_value_next_investigation: continue exact V57 HYPE alignment-v2 both-side lifecycle collection and reconcile the first eligible event end to end
recommendation.why: HYPE is already live, identity-exact, and development-promising; resolving its first active-window lifecycle has higher information value than adding economically contradicted or identity-unmeasured V58 routes.
recommendation.parallel_report_only_followup: resolve the SPCX short technical path and collect its first exact short lifecycle without changing the live route

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: Historical cadence can rotate materially by regime.
Sparse exact forward samples can make both positive and negative results misleading.
Point-in-time V58 liquidity preflight can become stale before a future cutover.
Provider overlap and one-position-per-symbol occupancy can reduce realized frequency below marginal route counts.
The V58 46% maximum isolated-margin topology magnifies the cost of adding a false-positive route.
No covariance or causal co-trigger model converts these route results into a joint portfolio expectancy.
falsifiers: An exact provider-symbol-side artifact contradicts a stated trade count, side, window, or after-cost result.
V57 HYPE produces repeated resolved losses or a technical contract mismatch that lowers its information priority.
A preregistered source-compatible V58 route produces positive both-side or justified one-side forward economics after exact costs and largest-winner removal.
SPCX development risk paths become fully resolved and its frozen short route remains positive under stress and prospective execution.
A portfolio-level causal replay with exact co-trigger timing shows V58 opportunity and risk materially differ from this route-by-route diagnosis.
The V58 config, profile fingerprint, route identity, leverage, sizing, or preflight evidence changes.
